title: Puja Sanskar Admin — Full Manual
subtitle: From setting up the shop to selling: every page, every box and every column, in plain words.

chapters.title: 0 · Before you start
chapters.nepali: Suru garnu aghi yo padhnus.
chapters.intro: The sidebar on the left goes in the order the work is done: 1 Setup, 2 Items, 3 Buy, 4 Stock, 5 Kits and pujas, 6 Sell, 7 Money. Do them in that order the first time.
steps: Look at the top bar: Staging (yellow strip) is for practice; anything can be deleted. Production is real work: things already bought or sold cannot be deleted.
Main branch (top right) is the shop whose stock you see and change.
A red * next to a box means it must be filled.
Leaving a page with typed work asks first: Discard or Keep editing.
An (i) next to a column name explains that column; hover or tap it.
terms: One thing the shop sells: अबिर (रातो) - साधारण. Each size or quality is its own item (Rule B): तामाको थाली सानो and तामाको थाली ठूलो are two items.
How one item is sold: 50 g, 100 g, 1 kg, 1 set, 1.5 m. One item can be sold in many sizes (Rule A). Each size has its own price and its own stock.
The size stock is bought in: 1 kg (25 kg bag = 25 × 1 kg), 1 m (100 m roll). It is turned into small sizes with Make packets. It stays off sale unless you give it a price.
Groups items of the same thing for search and puja lists: अबिर holds Abir Sadharan and Abir Special. A puja's samagri list names search groups, not items.
Big shelf of the shop and the website: आधारभूत सामग्री, हवन सामग्री… (the sheet names of the item Excel).
A list you make yourself (Tihar items, Copper vessels). Can sit inside another group. Shown on the website as a filter when you tick it.
Many items sold together for one puja: लक्ष्मी पूजा किट. Packages: Basic, Standard, Premium.
Grey / yellow / white rows in Excel
Grey = already in the shop, locked. Pale yellow = may be changed (price, supplier). White = new rows you can fill.

chapters.title: 1.1 · Categories
chapters.nepali: Pasal ra website ko thulo khanda (shelf).
chapters.intro: Made once. Items are filed under a category. The 5 categories from your Excel are already there.
fields: Shown on the website menu and item lists.
Empty = top level. Choosing one makes this a sub-category inside it.
Smaller number comes first in menus.
Off hides the category and its items from the website menu.
tips: Do not delete a category that has items; move the items first.

chapters.title: 1.2 · Units
chapters.nepali: Naap: g, kg, ml, L, m, pcs, set, मुठा…
chapters.intro: The words sizes are counted in. Already made: g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, pcs, pack, box, set, pair, bundle (मुठा), leaf (पात), kit, dala, ghari, stalk, plant, roll, skein. Add one only if a new kind of size is needed.
fields: The short word shown everywhere: 1 kg, 50 g.
Decides which items may use it: rice (By weight) only gets g and kg.

chapters.title: 1.3 · Colours and sizes
chapters.nepali: Rang (rato, pahenlo) ra size (S, M, L) ko list.
chapters.intro: Only for items bought in colours or clothing sizes (cloth in red and yellow; a kurta in S, M, L). Puja items whose sizes are weights or counts (50 g, 5 pcs) do not need this.
steps: Press "Add common colours and sizes" once: Red, Yellow, White, Black… and S, M, L, XL are made.
When you buy a red cloth, choose Red in the Buy line's "Colour or size": red cloth comes into stock and is sold as red.

chapters.title: 1.4 · Suppliers
chapters.nepali: Jaha bata saman kinchhau: pasal, thok, kishan.
chapters.where: Sidebar → 1 Setup → Suppliers (or "+ New supplier" on the Buy page)
chapters.intro: Needed before buying. 8 sample suppliers are there (Asan, Patan, Bhaktapur, Pharping, Kalimati, Birgunj, Janakpur, Indra Chowk); their phone numbers are made up.
fields: Shown on bills and the Buy page. The code is made by itself.
Fill it for a VAT-registered seller. In the Buy sheet a blank VAT then means the item's VAT; without a PAN it means 0%.
How many days after a bill you pay them.
What the shop already owed them before using this system.
columns: Bills not yet paid, minus payments.
Off hides them from the Buy page.

chapters.title: 2.1 · Add item
chapters.nepali: Saman ko naam matra. Rang/size, kati ra mol pachhi Buy ma.
chapters.intro: Say what the item is, nothing more. Rule B: each size (सानो/मझौला/ठूलो) or quality (साधारण/स्पेसल) is its own item — add each one separately.
fields: Without colour (red cloth is just "Cloth"; colour comes when buying). Must not be the same as another item.
Shown on the website and the bill.
By piece / By weight / By length / By litre / By size
Decides the units offered when buying: By weight → g, kg; By length → m.
Where it is filed in the shop and website.
Helps people find it typing English letters.
More search words; Enter after each.
Chosen first on the Buy page.
Only when a warning says a similar name exists but this really is a different item.
steps: Fill the boxes and press Save item.
Then choose: Buy it now (go to Buy with this item), Add another item, or Open the item.
tips: Many items at once? Use All items → Upload Excel (chapter 2.4).

chapters.title: 2.2 · All items (the list)
chapters.nepali: Pasal ko sabai saman ko list.
columns: Photo, Nepali name, English name. Click Open to see the item.
The sizes it is sold in: 50 g · 100 g · 1 kg. "+2" = two more. A dotted chip = that size has no selling price (not on sale). Click to jump to its stock and prices.
Its selling price; with many sizes, the cheapest.
On = on the website and can be sold. Off = hidden.
Open = the item page. Box icon = Archive (hide an item you stopped selling; it can come back). Bin = Delete.
steps: Search: type any name, Nepali or English.
Every group: show only the items of one item group.
Download Excel: the whole list, one sheet per category, in your Excel layout.
Upload Excel: add new items and change prices and suppliers (chapter 2.4).

chapters.title: 2.3 · The item page
chapters.nepali: Euta saman ko sabai kura euta page ma, tab bina.
chapters.where: All items → Open (or click the item anywhere)
columns: Three lines: selling price, stock, photo. Yellow = still to do, with the button that does it. Green = done.
One line per size: 1 set, 50 g, 1.5 m.
How many of that size are in the shop: "18 × 1.5 m" = 18 pieces of 1.5 m. "None — buy" = buy it first.
What one cost when bought (from the bills).
Type the price (Rs, VAT included) and press Save. A size not on sale shows "Put on sale".
Green = can be sold. Click it to take that size off sale.
fields: Edit name and website text → Names
Change the Nepali and English names.
Edit name and website text → Website text
A line or two under the name on the website.
Edit name and website text → Show on the website
Add another size → How much + Unit + Sell for
A new size of the same item (2 kg next to 1 kg), on sale at once.
The first photo is the main one. Shown for: leave "All colours and sizes", or pick one colour if the photo shows only it.
Tick the groups it belongs to; the × removes it from a group.
tips: Expert settings (link at the bottom): tax, HS code, offers, quality grades, "goes with". Rarely needed.

chapters.title: 2.4 · Item list in Excel
chapters.nepali: Dherai saman ekaipatak: Excel ma lekhera upload.
chapters.where: All items → Download Excel / Upload Excel
chapters.intro: Same layout as your master list. Each sheet is a category. The first sheet (गृहपृष्ठ) has the rules.
columns: Nepali name. Each size/quality is its own row (Rule B).
Must be different from every other item; add Small/Medium/Large, Regular/Special.
Search group: अबिर, कलश, धूप. Same word = same group. A new word makes a new group.
Only for reading; how it sells is found from the sizes.
The sizes, comma between: 50 gm, 100 gm, 1 kg — or 1 पिस, 5 पिस — or सानो प्याक, ठूलो बक्स. Empty = 1 piece.
One price per size in the same order: 35, 65, 580. A blank place keeps that size as it is. A price puts that size on sale.
Pick from the list: who you usually buy it from.
What to use if it is not found, or what it is for; shown as website text.
Made by the shop; do not touch. Leave empty for new rows.
steps: Download Excel. Grey rows are in the shop (locked); only their yellow price and supplier can change.
Write new items in the white rows below. A new sheet = a new category (sheet name = category name).
Upload Excel → Choose the .xlsx → Check the file. Mistakes are listed by sheet, row and column; nothing is saved until all are fixed.
Press Import. Uploading the same file again adds only the new rows.

chapters.title: 2.5 · Selling price and Item groups
chapters.nepali: Mol ek thau ma; samuha banaune.
chapters.where: Sidebar → 2 Items → Selling price / Item groups
steps: Selling price: every size of every item with its price, to change many at once.

Item groups: make a group (Tihar Items), put it inside another (Festival Items → Tihar Items → Laxmi Puja Items), tick "Show on website" to make it a website filter, and add items or kits to it. Many groups at once: Pujas, kits and groups Excel (chapter 5.3).

chapters.title: 3.1 · Buy (bring stock in)
chapters.nepali: Bazar bata kineko saman: kun, kati, kati ma. Save garda stock ma thapincha.
fields: Who sold it. Not in the list? "+ New supplier" (name and phone) right there.
The number on the paper bill. Empty = one is made.
What was bought. Not in the list? Add item first.
Only for coloured/sized items; what comes from red cloth stays red.
How much came: 25 kg bag, 100 m roll, 20 pcs. It is stored as 25 × "1 kg" (the bulk size).
What one kg / m / pcs cost, without VAT.
Optional: filled in, that size goes on sale now.
As the item's tax / 13% / No VAT
VAT bill = 13%. No VAT bill (farmer, small seller) = No VAT.
For food, ghee, flowers. Shown later on Expiring stock.
columns: How much × cost; the line under shows it with VAT.
Before VAT / VAT / Total to pay
The bill's totals at the bottom.
steps: Fill the top (supplier, bill no., date), then one line per thing bought. "Add another item" adds a line.
Press Save: the bill is saved and everything goes into stock at once.
Missing something? The box turns red and a message says what.
tips: While the shop is not VAT registered (Settings → Business), VAT paid is added to the cost.
Many bills at once: "Buy many with Excel" (chapter 3.2).

chapters.title: 3.2 · Buy many with Excel (Buy sheet)
chapters.nepali: Dherai bill ekaipatak.
chapters.where: Buy page or Purchase bills → Upload Excel → Download the layout
columns: Rows with the same supplier + bill number = one bill.
2026-11-21; the same on every row of one bill.
Pick or type the Nepali name.
kg, g, m, pcs, L… must fit how the item sells.
Cost of one unit, before VAT.
13 or 0. Blank: 0 if the supplier has no PAN, else the item's VAT.
Optional selling price: puts that size on sale.
steps: The Example sheet shows filled rows (rice 25 kg, ghee 5 L, red cloth 100 m).
Check the file, then Import: each bill is saved and goes into stock.
A bill already entered (same supplier + bill no.) is skipped, so nothing is doubled.

chapters.title: 3.3 · Purchase bills
chapters.nepali: Kineko bill haru.
columns: How many things on the bill.
VAT and the amount to pay.
Draft = saved, not in stock yet (✓ posts it). Posted = in stock.
tips: In Staging a posted bill can be deleted; its stock goes back out.

chapters.title: 4.1 · Stock
chapters.nepali: Kati saman baki chha.
columns: What all stock cost (VAT included while not VAT registered).
How many item sizes have stock.
Sizes never bought or sold out.
The size the stock is counted in: 1 set, 1 L, 1 kg.
How many of that size: 5 = 5 sets; 0.2 = 0.2 L. Click the number to correct it after counting.
OK = enough. Low = below the warning level. None = sold out. "2 kept for orders" shows only when customer orders hold some.
Set with ✏️: below this it shows as Low.
steps: Filters: category, item group, supplier, brand, item; All / Running low / No stock.
Row buttons: Damaged / lost (broken, expired, missing: stock goes down as a loss), Count (type what you counted), Make packets (chapter 4.2).
⋯ menu: History (every in and out), Update, Send to another branch; in Staging also Delete this stock.

chapters.title: 4.2 · Make packets (big to small sizes)
chapters.nepali: Thok (bora, than) kholera sano pack banaune.
chapters.where: Stock → Make packets on the bulk size's row
fields: How many of the bulk pack are opened
70 (of a 100 m roll stored as 1 m)
Taken out of the bulk size.
Smaller packs that come out → Pack + How many
Added to stock. "+ A new pack" makes a size that does not exist yet.
steps: Example cloth: 100 m bought → open 70 → 20 × 1.5 m (30 m) + 20 × 2 m (40 m); 30 m stays on the roll.
Example rice: 25 kg bag → open 10 → 10 × 500 g + 25 × 200 g; 15 kg stays in the bag.
The screen shows what was opened, what the packs make, and any wastage; the cost is shared over the new packs.

chapters.title: 4.3 · Expiring stock and Archive
chapters.nepali: Miti sakine saman; bechna chhodeko saman.
steps: Expiring stock: everything with an "Expires on" date from Buy, soonest first. Write off = remove expired stock as a loss.
Archive: items and kits you stopped selling. Restore brings them back; Not sold for (days) finds items to retire.

chapters.title: 5.1 · Kits
chapters.nepali: Euta puja ko lagi dherai saman ek sath.
fields: Which puja the kit is for.
Each package has its own items, photo and discount.
What is inside. Each item size must be on sale.
Taken off the items' total when bought as a kit.
tips: The fastest way: in the Excel (chapter 5.3) write "Make from puja samagri = हो" and the kit is filled from the puja's samagri list.

chapters.title: 5.2 · Pujas and puja groups
chapters.nepali: Puja haru tah-tah ma (वर्ग → उपवर्ग → समूह).
steps: Puja groups form a tree, as deep as needed: चाडपर्व → दशैं → नवरात्र. Levels are called वर्ग, उपवर्ग, समूह.
Each puja sits in a group, has a type (पूजा, चाडपर्व, संस्कार, व्रत, शान्ति, श्राद्ध, पाठ, हवन) and a samagri list.
The samagri list names search groups (अबिर, धूप, कलश) with how much and Required / Optional. The website shows this list and the puja's kits.

chapters.title: 5.3 · Pujas, kits and groups Excel
chapters.nepali: Puja, kit ra samuha ekaipatak Excel bata.
chapters.where: Pujas, Kits or Item groups page → Upload Excel → Download the layout
chapters.intro: Fill the sheets in order; a name typed on one sheet can be used on the next.
columns: पूजा समूह: समूह, English, माथिको समूह
Group, its English name, and its parent group (empty = top). The parent makes the nesting, any depth.
The puja, its group and type.
पूजा सामग्री: पूजा, मूल सामग्री, कति, एकाइ, अनिवार्य/ऐच्छिक
One row per samagri a puja needs. Empty amount = "as the ritual needs".
किट: किट, English, पूजा, प्याकेज, पूजा सामग्रीबाट बनाउने?, छुट %
"हो" fills the kit from the puja's samagri (items on sale). "होइन" takes the items from the next sheet.
किटका सामान: किट, सामान, प्याक, कति वटा, ऐच्छिक?
Items and sizes (100 g, 1 pcs) in a kit.
सामान समूह: समूह, English, माथिको समूह, वेबसाइटमा देखाउने?
Item groups, nested the same way; "हो" makes a website filter.
समूहका सामान: समूह, सामान वा किट
steps: Grey rows are saved (locked); write in the empty rows.
Check the file, then Import. The same file uploaded again adds only new rows.

chapters.title: 6 · Sell
chapters.nepali: Pasal ma ra website bata bechne.
chapters.where: Sidebar → 6 Sell → Counter sale / Orders and bills / Customers
fields: Tap a kit or choose an item size.
Stock goes down at once; the sale opens as an order where payment is taken and the bill issued.
steps: Orders and bills: every sale from the counter and the website; take payment and print the bill there.
Customers: people who bought, with their orders.
tips: Bills need the business profile: Settings → Business (shop name, address, PAN, VAT registered or not).

chapters.title: 7 · Money, offers, website, settings
chapters.nepali: Paisa, offer, website ra setting.
steps: Cash and bank: the shop's accounts and what moved in and out.
Expenses: rent, salary, transport; Reports: what sold, by item and day.
Offers / Coupons / Pandits: price offers, coupon codes, and pandit partners.
Website → Pages and banners: FAQs, pages and the home banners.
Settings: Business profile (needed for bills), tax, delivery areas, branches. Staff: who may log in and what they may do. Clear data: wipes shop data (only when switched on).

chapters.title: Daily routine (checklist)
chapters.nepali: Hare din garne kam.
steps: Morning: Dashboard; Stock → Running low; Expiring stock.
Goods arrive: Buy (or the Buy sheet) with the paper bill.
Bulk opened: Stock → Make packets.
Customer in the shop: Counter sale → Orders and bills → payment and bill.
Something broken or expired: Stock → Damaged / lost.
New item: Add item → Buy → set the price on the item page.
End of day: Cash and bank; count a few shelves with Count.
